heard: A massive star is rocketing through space as a celestial fugitive. Betelgeuse is a red supergiant star located in the constellation of Orion. If placed at the center of the solar system, it would engulf the orbits of Mercury, Venus, Earth, and Mars. This ancient giant is a runaway star that was ejected from its birthplace near the stars in Orion's belt. The star is moving through space at a speed of 30 kilometers per second. Its movement creates a massive bow shock where its stellar wind crashes into the interstellar medium. This shockwave stretches roughly three to four light years wide in front of the fleeing giant. That is why a massive star is rocketing through space as a celestial fugitive.
